purpose: Isolate claim decomposition from claim selection by fixing the focal source-grounded claim before reconstruction.
forbidden_inputs_before_run_freeze: M14 v1 GPT-6.1 Sol replay outputs
execution_rules: Use exactly the source and anchor specified for each case.
Treat the supplied anchor as the target claim; do not replace it with another salient claim from the same source.
Use the original source as evidence for every structured commitment.
Do not infer retained structure from the wording of the anchor beyond what the source supports.
ABSTAIN if adequate full text cannot be obtained.
UNDERDETERMINED if the anchored claim cannot be stably decomposed from the source without unsupported extrapolation.
Preserve the first completed structured output as RAW before normalization.
Normalization may change serialization only, never scientific content.
Freeze all ten records for one named-model run before exposing that run to any retained answer, prior replay, or comparison result.
Execute the two named-model runs in separate fresh conversations and do not pass run A outputs to run B.
human_boundary: Procedural auditability may be measured separately; human inter-rater reliability remains unmeasured.
